##### SECTION M9 (zfs version -j, zfs list -j, zfs get -j: values with newline/tab/0xff/quote, every source type, sort, -p, received, errors; the -H references; the usage text on versions without -j)  tag=C  zfs-2.3.9-0+deb13u1
#note: names: tab, newline, a UTF-8 e-acute, a 0xff byte, '%', ',', '@', '#', a trailing space, a leading space, ':' and 'a b' (a space) are attempted; the created ones appear in the listings
=== CASE M9/00_name_tab
--- cmd
zfs create zfsbcapc/M9/$'t\tab'
--- rc
1
--- stdout
--- stderr
cannot create 'zfsbcapc/M9/t	ab': invalid character '	' in name
=== END

#note: setup: zfsbcapc/M9/src (compression=lz4, user props zfsb:nl='line1<LF>line2' zfsb:tab='a<TAB>b' zfsb:ff='a<0xff>b' zfsb:q='say "hi"' zfsb:bs='back\slash' zfsb:bsn='a\nb' (backslash, n) zfsb:ctl='x<0x01>y<0x7f>z' zfsb:u8='cafe-acute <U+1F600>' zfsb:json='{"a":[1,2]}' zfsb:dash='-' zfsb:fake='inherited from foo' zfsb:empty='' zfsb:lt='<&>'), children zz aa mm (created in that order), zfsbcapc/M9/vol (a zvol, 8M), zfsbcapc/M9/empty, snapshots s1 (recursive) and s2 (recursive), src/mm@extra, hold on src@s1, clone zfsbcapc/M9/clone of src@s1, bookmark src#bm1, zfsbcapc/M9/recv from zfs send -R src@s1, zfsbcapc/M9/tmp mounted ro
#note: big: zfsbcapc/M9/big is a dataset whose guid is >= 9223372036854775808 (tried g1..g40, the others destroyed)
#note: H*: the -H forms of the same objects (every version), for the -j vs -H parity test

	snapdir                YES      YES   disabled | hidden | visible
	snapshot_limit         YES       NO   <count> | none
	special_small_blocks   YES      YES   zero or 512 to 1M, power of 2
	sync                   YES      YES   standard | always | disabled
	utf8only                NO      YES   on | off
	version                YES       NO   1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | current
	volblocksize            NO      YES   512 to 128k, power of 2
	volmode                YES      YES   default | full | geom | dev | none
	volsize                YES       NO   <size>
	volthreading           YES       NO   on | off
	vscan                  YES      YES   on | off
	xattr                  YES      YES   on | off | dir | sa
	zoned                  YES      YES   on | off
	userused@...            NO       NO   <size>
	groupused@...           NO       NO   <size>
	projectused@...         NO       NO   <size>
	userobjused@...         NO       NO   <size>
	groupobjused@...        NO       NO   <size>
	projectobjused@...      NO       NO   <size>
	userquota@...          YES       NO   <size> | none
	groupquota@...         YES       NO   <size> | none
	projectquota@...       YES       NO   <size> | none
	userobjquota@...       YES       NO   <size> | none
	groupobjquota@...      YES       NO   <size> | none
	projectobjquota@...    YES       NO   <size> | none
	written@<snap>          NO       NO   <size>
	written#<bookmark>      NO       NO   <size>

Sizes are specified in bytes with standard units such as K, M, G, etc.

User-defined properties can be specified by using a name containing a colon (:).

The {user|group|project}[obj]{used|quota}@ properties must be appended with
a user|group|project specifier of one of these forms:
    POSIX name      (eg: "matt")
    POSIX id        (eg: "126829")
    SMB name@domain (eg: "matt@sun")
    SMB SID         (eg: "S-1-234-567-89")

Sizes are specified in bytes with standard units such as K, M, G, etc.

User-defined properties can be specified by using a name containing a colon (:).

The {user|group|project}[obj]{used|quota}@ properties must be appended with
a user|group|project specifier of one of these forms:
    POSIX name      (eg: "matt")
    POSIX id        (eg: "126829")
    SMB name@domain (eg: "matt@sun")
    SMB SID         (eg: "S-1-234-567-89")
